title: Index Funds Now Control 52% Of The Stock Market
hook: Index funds quietly grew from 2% to 52% of the market.
closing: Your index fund owns the shares, but giant managers cast the votes.
question: Who votes your index shares?

segments.say: Index funds rose from 2 percent in 2000 to 52 percent in 2024. Passive investing became the market's majority owner.
BlackRock, Vanguard, and State Street own 22 percent of a typical large company. The largest active manager holds only 4 percent.
Vanguard alone casts 9 percent of votes at major shareholder meetings. Passive ownership still creates concentrated power.
